messages:
Maya - Marketing: Quick sync — webinar Tues 4/15 10am PT. Need X + LinkedIn posting plan, CTA variants, asset owners, and SDR routing. Who can lead scheduling?
Alex - Growth: Ill run scheduling. Plan to A/B CTAs and test pinned reply on X. Need final copy by Mon EOD.
Sam - Content: Drafts ready. Two flavors: benchmark narrative (LinkedIn) + product walkthrough (X). Assets: GIF, 60s clip, 3-card carousel. I'll upload and tag filenames.
Maya - Marketing: Benchmark gets LinkedIn noon ET; X thread at 9:30am PT. Reminder tweet 30m prior.
Sam - Content: Uploaded to drive: https://drive.redwood/WEB-074. Filenames: WEB-074-gif, WEB-074-clip, WEB-074-carousel. Added alt text + suggested live replies.
Alex - Growth: Proposed schedule:
X: 2026-04-15T09:30:00-07:00
LinkedIn: 2026-04-15T12:00:00-04:00
X reminder: 2026-04-15T09:00:00-07:00
Will post pinned reply at T+2m if running test.
Rachel - SDR Ops: For registration form: add utm_source=social, utm_campaign=webinar_bench, utm_content={creative}. Hidden field channel=social. Route leads to #sdr-webinars and tag webinar_high for attendees. Will add dedupe by email.
Alex - Growth: Also want creative tokens for attribution (gif/clip/carousel). Good to know which creative drives signups.
Sam - Content: Appended utm_content to each CTA link. Two CTA openers for X: 1) Direct: "Sign up -> [link]" 2) Tease: "We cut inference cost 3x  see how".
Maya - Marketing: Engagement plan: live thread replies during webinar (Sam monitors), 24h recap post + clip, nurture email to registrants. Rachel  what's SDR follow-up?
Rachel - SDR Ops: 24h email + LI connect if they opened recap; 72h follow-up call for hot leads. Auto-tag attendees with Qs as hot. Will share templates after testing webhook.
ops-bot: Reminder set: "Finalize social copy" in #marketing at 2026-04-13T17:00:00Z.
Maya - Marketing: Final checklist: Sam final copy by Mon EOD, Alex schedules, Rachel confirms webhook & templates. Notify me today if we want paid boost.
Alex - Growth: I'll monitor first 90m organic and ping for budget if CTRs look good.
Sam - Content: Uploading alternate hooks and reply scripts now.
Rachel - SDR Ops: Webhook test scheduled 4pm today; will report back.
Maya - Marketing: Thanks — quick standup Mon AM if anything changes. :rocket:
